title: Sharp Convergence Rates for Masked Diffusion Models
abstract: arXiv:2602.22505v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Discrete diffusion models have achieved strong empirical performance in text and other symbolic domains, with masked (absorbing-rate) variants emerging as competitive alternatives to autoregressive models. Among existing samplers, the Euler method remains the standard choice in many applications, and more recently, the First-Hitting Sampler (FHS) has shown considerable promise for masked diffusion models. Despite their practical success, the theoretical understanding of these samplers remains incomplete. Many existing analyses are conducted in Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence, which often yields loose parameter dependencies and requires strong assumptions on score estimation. Moreover, these guarantees do not cover recently developed high-performance sampler of FHS. In this work, we first develop a direct total-variation (TV)-based analysis for the Euler method that overcomes these limitations. Our results relax assumptions on score

translated_title: 掩码扩散模型的精确收敛速率
translated_abstract: 离散扩散模型在文本及其他符号领域取得了出色的实证表现，其中掩码（吸收率）变体已成为自回归模型的有力竞争替代方案。在现有采样器中，欧拉方法仍是许多应用中的标准选择，而最近，首达采样器（FHS）在掩码扩散模型中展现出可观的潜力。尽管这些采样器在实践中取得了成功，但对其理论理解仍不完善。许多现有分析基于Kullback-Leibler (KL) 散度进行，这通常导致参数依赖关系较为松散，并且需要对分数估计施加较强的假设。此外，这些理论保证未能覆盖最近开发的高性能采样器FHS。在这项工作中，我们首次为欧拉方法开发了直接基于总变差的 分析，克服了上述局限。我们的结果放松了对分数估计的假设要求。
tldr: 本文首次为掩码扩散模型中的欧拉采样方法建立了直接基于总变差 的精确收敛速率分析，克服了现有KL散度分析参数依赖松散、假设过强以及无法覆盖首达采样器（FHS）的局限。
en_tdlr: This paper develops the first direct total-variation (TV)-based sharp convergence rate analysis for the Euler sampler in masked diffusion models, overcoming the loose parameter dependencies, strong score estimation assumptions, and lack of FHS coverage inherent in prior KL-divergence-based analyses.
